summary:
Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, CHANGELOG.md, and tests/test_progress.py, following the spec. Nothing was run or committed, as instructed.

- TaskProgressColumn: new last keyword show_speed (default False), stored on the instance. New classmethod render_speed(speed) returns styled Text: empty for None, otherwise scaled via filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix with the suffix list and base 1000, formatted to one decimal plus suffix and " it/s". render() returns the speed text when total is None and show_speed is on, using finished_speed if not None, else speed. Otherwise the existing path is unchanged.
- track() helper: new last parameter show_speed (default True), documented in Args, passed to TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=...).
- Progress.track: total is explicit total, else len() if Sized, else None. No longer raises for unsized iterables.
- CHANGELOG: line added under Unreleased / Added.
- Tests: added test_task_progress_column_speed covering None, 5, 5000, 8888888. Removed the two pytest.raises(ValueError) blocks for track(5) and progress.track(5).

Not verified: tests were not run, so the changes are checked by reading only.
